text: Relentless means never easing up or giving up. Here, Casey kept looking for better ways to deliver packages, again and again.
Fledgling means new and just starting out. A fledgling is also a young bird that has just grown its feathers. Here, Casey's little messenger service was only a beginning.
To poach is to sneakily lure away something that belongs to someone else, like a customer. Casey's long contracts made it hard for rivals to do that.
A biographer is a writer who tells the story of a real person's life.
Reclusive means preferring to be alone and staying out of public view. Casey rarely talked to reporters.
Memoirs are a book where someone writes about their own life. Casey wrote none.
Doggedly means in a stubborn way that does not quit, like a dog that will not let go of a stick. The biographer had to keep searching for facts.
Globalisation is the way countries around the world become more connected by trading goods, sharing ideas and traveling. Shipping makes it possible.
The Fortune 500 is a yearly list of the 500 biggest companies in the United States, ranked by how much money they bring in.
A messenger service is a business that carries packages and notes from one place to another.
Retailers are businesses that sell things to the public, like stores. Casey delivered what department stores sold.
To turn a profit means to earn more money than you spend. With each trip paying only a few cents, that was hard.
To consolidate is to combine many small things into one bigger one. Casey gathered all the packages in one place instead of making many separate trips.
A premium is an extra amount of money paid for something special. Customers paid more for same-day delivery.
Here, volume means the amount of work, or how many packages there are to deliver. It does not mean loudness.
Surety is certainty or safety. Long contracts gave Casey the sure knowledge that money would keep coming in.
Rivals are people or companies that compete with you for the same customers or prizes.
Scrabbling means hunting around in a hurry and clumsily, like looking through a messy bag for your keys.
A benchmark is a standard number you compare against to see whether you are ahead or behind.
A bonus is extra pay as a reward for good work.
Commonplace means usual and seen everywhere. Timing workers is now commonplace at many companies.
Automation means using machines to do work that people used to do by hand, like sorting packages.
Unapologetic means not feeling sorry or ashamed. Casey made no excuses for wanting efficient ways of working.
Eradicated means completely wiped out, destroyed so nothing is left.
To hound someone is to chase and bother them without stopping, like a hunting hound. UPS kept bothering its challengers.
Umpteen means too many to count, a very large number.
To flout a rule is to openly ignore or break it. Here, UPS broke the rules of fair competition.
Antitrust laws stop companies from cheating to wipe out all their competition, so shoppers keep having choices.
An exclusive contract is a deal where a customer promises to use only one company. That locks out the company's rivals.
To carve up markets means to divide them up, like slicing a cake, so each company gets its own area and they do not compete.
An exemption is a special permission to skip a rule that others must follow.
Ahead of his time means having ideas or methods that other people would only use much later.
A taskmaster is a boss who demands a lot of hard work.
Ruthless means harsh and without pity, willing to hurt others to win.
De rigueur is French for expected and required by current fashion or custom. Here, it means a ruthless attitude had become the normal thing in business.
Entrepreneurs are people who start their own businesses.
Silicon Valley is the area in California where many famous technology companies began.
Packard was a company that made fancy cars in the early 1900s.
Amazon is a huge company that sells almost everything online and delivers it to homes.
The New Yorker is a well-known American magazine.
UPS stands for United Parcel Service, a company famous for its brown trucks that deliver packages.
